description.p: Ubuntu Passkey turns your computer into a FIDO2 security key, so you can create and use passkeys on any website that supports them, in any browser, without extra hardware.

ul.li: Works with Chrome, Chromium, Firefox, Edge and Brave
Passkeys are encrypted with a key kept in your login keyring
Confirm sign-ins with your password or fingerprint
Approval prompts integrated into GNOME Shell

screenshot.caption: Manage the passkeys stored on this computer
